prefixDef.p: URIs using the q prefix are Wikidata Q identifiers and refer to the respective entries on Wikidata.
Private URIs using the g prefix are pointers to the respective lemmas in the FFDB collection of glossaries. Glossaries were taken from the original text source.

body.p: Two women ran away from their husbands. The other had a baby in a cradle. They went far away, to other [StN]: cradle unmarkedcountries. They rode away on the backs of reindeer. They took three reindeer bulls with them. They walk and walk. A large mountain pass, a mountain ridge, they walked far, they walked along this mountain ridge.[StN]: UÉ£nim dawaj - ??? They couldn't find any water. One of them made a basket. One urinate in the basket, the other milked in the basket to drink, the other urinate in the basket. They are thirsty. They can't find any water. One of them drank her own urine. The other drank milk. The one who drank her urine did not die. The one who milked their milk and drank their own [milk], [when] they could not find water, died.[StN]: dÊ¼ani - 1) ptcp.fut (instead of inf) or not? 2) nitÉkÉn The other drank urine and did not die.
